name: KeyStone Co-Pack Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: KeyStone CoPack is your trusted partner for premium supplement manufacturing. From R&D to blending, filling, and packaging, we provide full turnkey services to bring your product to market with quality and efficiency.
about:
KeyStone Co-Pack Manufacturing, LLC is based in Pleasant Grove, Utah. The company does not publish its founding date or ownership details, but it presents itself as a turnkey co-pack partner for supplement and personal-care brands.

The firm provides end-to-end contract manufacturing for nutritional and cosmetic products. Its service chain covers ideation, formulation development, raw-material sourcing, production, packaging, and fulfillment. Production capabilities include powder blending and filling, capsule and tablet manufacturing, and packaging in jars, gusseted bags, bottles, sticks, sachets, tubs, and vials. The company notes a large inventory of hundreds of ingredients and custom formulas, but does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

KeyStone serves three primary industry groups: Food & Beverage (protein powders, baking mixes, unpasteurized beverage shots), Health & Wellness (protein blends, electrolytes, pre-workouts, performance and wellness powdered supplements), and Personal Care & Beauty (hair care, skin care, oral care products). Customers range from start-up brands to established companies seeking a single-source partner.

The company emphasizes its turnkey model as a differentiator, citing cost efficiency, access to a wider supplier network, regulatory knowledge, and specialized expertise. It also highlights responsible sourcing practices and nearby fulfillment partners to shorten delivery times.
